items.title: Explicit local p-adic Galois images in the non-split Cartan normalizer from supersingular Hodge deformation
items.author: Matthew Bisatt; Lorenzo Furio; Davide Lombardo
items.difficulty_reason: The local classification combines explicit filtered (phi,G)-module parameters, alternative torsion division polynomials, integral Tate lattices, ramification growth and formal-logarithm determination of the Hodge deformation parameter. It produces exact levels and index-one/three alternatives under original p>7, defect and valuation restrictions, not merely a recurrence or global application. Full author proof and parameter algorithm retained without rerunning calculations.

primary.label: complete original precise local p-adic image theorem, all valuation and index-three conditions
